name: Garden of Roses: Summerset
source:
You play Will Getz, a hot-headed young man with unfinished business and a score to settle. When you were seven years old, you left the town you'd grown up in in in the middle of the night, never to return. Fifteen years later, you return to the sleepy town of Edelton to finish things where you left off. Everything is exactly as you remember it, even the arrangement of the furniture.

While in town, you find yourself drawn to a harpy girl named Rosa Oaks, a pitiable girl inheriting a cursed family fortune and all the misery that accompanies it. Figures from the past and present cross paths over the two weeks you spend closing the lid on the past, culminating in an ending of your own choosing.

At the end of it all, surrounded by your new friends, you try with all your might to remember something you've been forgetting for well over a decade:

What happened, on that night?

Welcome to Edelton, a twilight town of Rose and Ash.

[from [url=https://outismedia.itch.io/garden-of-roses-vn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演Will Getz，一个脾气急躁、还有往事未了、有旧账待算的年轻人。七岁时，你在深夜离开了成长的小镇，从此再未回去。十五年后，你重返沉寂的Edelton，准备了结当年未竟之事。这里的一切都和记忆中一模一样，连家具的摆放也没有变。

在镇上，你不由自主地被一位名叫Rosa Oaks的鹰身女妖吸引。这位可怜的女孩继承了被诅咒的家产，也承受着随之而来的所有苦难。在你用来为过去画上句号的两周里，往昔与当下的人物相继交会，最终走向由你亲自选择的结局。

当一切结束，新朋友们围绕在身边时，你竭尽所能，想记起一件早已遗忘十多年的事：

那个夜晚，究竟发生了什么？

欢迎来到Edelton，一座玫瑰与灰烬交织的暮色小镇。

[摘自[url=https://outismedia.itch.io/garden-of-roses-vn]itch.io[/url]]
